summary: Uber Technologies filed a routine Form 8-K on September 15, 2026, reporting completion of a registered multi-tranche investment-grade bond offering: $750M 3.750% notes due 2029, $1B 4.125% notes due 2032, $1B 4.375% notes due 2034, $1B 4.750% notes due 2038, and $750M 5.250% notes due 2046, totaling $4.5B of senior unsecured debt. Underwriters were represented by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Deutsche Bank, BofA and BNP Paribas. Net proceeds are designated for general corporate purposes. This ordinary shelf takedown under Form S-3 is not a special situation; no change of control, tender or capital-return element arises.
